newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quotes steady but may drop.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quotes steady but may drop.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were steady on Thursday but some traders said suppliers might lower their prices later amid thin demand.

"Demand is slow so far, so some suppliers may drop prices to get a slice of the market," said one trader. The 380-cst grade was quoted by majors at above $100 per tonne while independents offered $2-$3 per tonne lower. MDO and gas oil stabilsed at around their recent levels at $198 and $215 respectively.
However, sentiment was supported by tight supplies in South Korea, Singapore's main competitor, as well as firm crude values, traders said. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3571)
